content:
We need to propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: steps forward are: 1) amide formation (carboxylic acid to amide). 2) Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid). 3) sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). So retrosynthetic steps reverse: target -> break amide to give acid + amine; break α,β-unsaturated acid to give aldehyde + malonic acid (or maybe malonic acid + aldehyde). Then break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride + amine.

Thus we need to propose precursors: final target has a sulfonamide linking a tolyl amine (p-tolyl) to a sulfonyl phenyl ring bearing the unsaturated amide side chain.

Structure: p-tolyl (CH3 on phenyl) attached to N of sulfonamide (SO2). The sulfonyl attached to another phenyl ring (para-substituted) bearing the side chain /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH (anilide). So retrosynthesis:

Step 3 (forward sulfonamide formation): React p-toluidine (4-methyl aniline) with sulfonyl chloride: ClSO2-Ph-para-(C=C-CO-NH-Ph-NH). So precursor: p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1) and sulfonyl chloride: ClSO2-c2ccc(... )cc2 where the sulfonyl chloride has the rest of molecule attached: the phenyl ring with side chain as a carboxylic acid? Actually sulfonyl chloride attaches to N, leaving the rest of molecule as sulfonyl phenyl with side chain attached via the phenyl ring (no further functional groups). The side chain includes α,β-unsaturated amide. In forward direction, sulfonyl chloride is attached to aromatic ring (the sulfonyl group attached to phenyl). So the sulfonyl chloride precursor is: ClSO2-c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 . That's a sulfonyl chloride with the unsaturated amide side chain already present. So step 2: that side chain is formed via amide formation from acid and amine. The acid precursor: the α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid: c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2 (para phenyl with cinnamic acid). Then amide formation with aniline (c3ccccc3N) to give the amide. So step 1: the cinnamic acid is formed via Doebner modification from aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So overall:

Target -> disconnection 1: sulfonamide cleavage -> p-toluidine + sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride with cinnamic acid side chain). Then disconnection 2: amide cleavage -> cinnamic acid + aniline. Then disconnection 3: cinnamic acid via Doebner -> p-tolyl aldehyde? Wait the aldehyde is the same phenyl ring (c2ccc(CHO)cc2). So we need aldehyde precursor: p-tolyl aldehyde (4-methylbenzaldehyde) (Cc1ccc(CHO)cc1). And malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So final three steps.

Thus we need to produce JSON route with three reaction nodes.

We need template IDs for each step. We have template 401931 which seems to be amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine to give amide with double bond). That template matches our amide formation step (carboxylic acid to amide). So we can use template_id 401931 for step 2 (amide formation). For sulfonamide formation, need a template. Search for sulfonamide formation.
